schema.text: When you ride an e-scooter, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of by e-scooter)

en.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: When you ride an e-scooter, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?
en.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: I notice it, but I don't change anything
en.#I take another route or travel at anoth: I take another route or travel at another time
en.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
en.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of by e-scooter)

it.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Quando vai in monopattino elettrico, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Prendo un altro percorso o mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in autobus invece che in monopattino)

fr.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Lorsque vous roulez en trottinette électrique, que faites-vous quand l’air est mauvais (gaz d’échappement, poussière, mauvaises odeurs) ?
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Je prends un autre itinéraire ou je me déplace à un autre moment
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Je me protège, par ex. avec un masque
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus plutôt qu'en trottinette)

de.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Was tun Sie beim E-Scooter-Fahren, wenn die Luft schlecht ist (Abgase, Staub, schlechte Gerüche)?
de.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Ich merke es, ändere aber nichts
de.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Ich nehme eine andere Route oder fahre zu einer anderen Zeit
de.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Ich schütze mich, z. B. mit einer Maske
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Bus statt E-Scooter)

tr.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Elektrikli scooter kullanırken hava kötü olduğunda (egzoz dumanı, toz, kötü kokular) ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Fark ederim ama hiçbir şeyi değiştirmem
tr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Başka bir güzergâh seçerim veya başka bir saatte yolculuk ederim
tr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. elektrikli scooter yerine otobüsle)

fa.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: هنگام استفاده از اسکوتر برقی، وقتی هوا بد است (دود اگزوز، گردوغبار، بوی بد) چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#Nothing, it doesn't affect me: هیچ کاری، بر من اثری ندارد
fa.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: متوجه می‌شوم، اما چیزی را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#I take another route or travel at anoth: مسیر دیگری می‌روم یا در زمان دیگری سفر می‌کنم
fa.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: از خودم محافظت می‌کنم، مثلاً با ماسک
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با اتوبوس به جای اسکوتر برقی)

hu.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: Mit tesz elektromos rollerezés közben, ha rossz a levegő (kipufogógáz, por, kellemetlen szagok)?
hu.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Más útvonalat választok, vagy más időpontban utazom
hu.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Más módon utazom (pl. busszal elektromos roller helyett)

ar.#When you ride an e-scooter, what do you: عند ركوب السكوتر الكهربائي، ما تصرّفك عندما يكون الهواء سيئًا (عوادم، غبار، روائح كريهة)؟
ar.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: ألاحظ ذلك، لكنني لا أغيّر شيئًا
ar.#I take another route or travel at anoth: أسلك طريقًا آخر أو أتنقل في وقت آخر
ar.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: أتنقل بطريقة أخرى (مثلًا بالحافلة بدل السكوتر الكهربائي)
